title: Injectivity of an Exponential Tent Transform
description:
Proofs and reproducible numerical checks for the uniqueness of the inverse problem for the exponential tent transform, the mean transformation time in the one-dimensional Kolmogorov–Johnson–Mehl–Avrami model.

Equal transforms of two nonnegative locally integrable densities force equality whenever their difference has uniformly bounded mass on unit intervals. In particular the transform is injective on nonnegative Lp densities for every 1 ≤ p ≤ ∞, including infinite-mass L2 densities, with no smoothness or decay assumption.

The release also includes an exact second-order identity, information about the density read directly from the transform, a controlled-tail injectivity theorem, and periodic local inversion, stability, regularity and reconstruction results. No closed-form inverse or literature-priority claim is made.

The results were developed with AI assistance and checked by an independent AI-assisted review. They have not been peer reviewed or formally verified.
